fuel_gauge.definition: sigma_fund[anchor] = 1e4 * population sd (ddof=0) of the cross-section of 8h-equivalent funding rates rn8 = f_fund_now * 8 / f_fund_iv
fuel_gauge.causality: f_fund_now[j] = fr[searchsorted(ft, anchor, side='right')-1] (pod_panel_ext.py L153-155) = last SETTLED rate at or before the anchor, NaN if staler than 12h. Strictly available at the anchor.

round6_reconciliation.device_defect_found_in_r6j1_regime.py: umap.get(j) looks a panel ROW INDEX up in a TIMESTAMP-keyed dict, so the CRYPTO umask is never applied for t <= last_mask_ts; only the September tail gets UMM[-1]. Effect on the gauge is small (<1.2 bp on monthly medians) and does not change any conclusion.

headline_findings.1_premise_correction_monotone: The seven-month decline is NOT monotone. LIVE monthly medians 2026-02..2026-09 = 19.60 14.35 13.29 6.28 16.55 12.79 9.78 8.20. One of seven month-on-month steps is UP, by +10.27 bp (2026-05 -> 2026-06), larger than the entire claimed decline. Same on the R6 gauge (7.04 -> 17.72).
headline_findings.2_premise_correction_level: Today is not a historical low. September 2026 median 8.20 bp (LIVE) sits at the 69.5th percentile of post-warm full history (median 4.09). 2025-07 (6.08), 2025-08 (6.63) and 2026-05 (6.28) all read BELOW today.
headline_findings.3_pooled_curve_exists: Pooled decile means for A0 do rise with dispersion: deciles 1-5 (sigma<4.54) average -0.106 bps/anchor; deciles 6-10 average +1.373. Best-fitting step is at tau=4.75 bp: E[g|sigma<4.75] = -0.1548 CI95 [-0.708,+0.386]; E[g|sigma>=4.75] = +1.4552 CI95 [+0.667,+2.221].
headline_findings.5_within_era_flat_and_sign_flips: Within-year demeaned sigma quintiles: -0.021 -0.403 -0.029 +0.232 +0.220 (cluster SE ~0.52). Year-FE slope on sigma = -0.0367 CI95 [-0.1129,+0.0374] (pooled slope +0.0165 CI95 [-0.0456,+0.0840]). Split at 8.20 within eras: 2022-2024 high-sigma -0.314 vs low-sigma +0.013 (NEGATIVE); 2025-2026 high +2.060 vs low +0.947 (POSITIVE).
headline_findings.6_out_of_window_test_fails: Fit on everything through 2026-08-10 20Z, predict the next 120 anchors (2026-08-11..08-30 20Z, median sigma 9.03 = today's level). Linear curve predicts +0.750, decile curve predicts +1.469; ACTUAL -3.4859 (s42, SR -4.707) / -2.9170 (s2027). Prediction error -4.24 to -4.96 bps/anchor, wrong sign.
headline_findings.7_the_one_identified_channel: carry_ex/gross (the funding the book PAYS; device: net = pnl - carry - cost) is the ONLY component with a relationship to sigma that survives year fixed effects: pooled b=+0.02116 R2=0.1428 CI95 [+0.01603,+0.02676]; year-FE b=+0.01138 CI95 [+0.00499,+0.01810]. pnl_ex/gross year-FE b=-0.0250 CI95 [-0.0957,+0.0480]; net_ex/gross year-FE b=-0.0367 CI95 [-0.1101,+0.0386]. The book is funding-MOMENTUM, net short carry: it pays 0.4797 bps/anchor on average, and it pays MORE when dispersion is higher. On the identified channel, falling dispersion is a TAILWIND worth +0.24 bps/anchor going 19.60 -> 8.20 = +10.5% of NAV/yr at 2.0x gross.

a_zero_crossing.linear_form: sigma* = -a/b = -30.13 bp, CI95 [-244.1,+247.0]; only 35.6% of bootstrap draws put it above zero. The linear intercept a=+0.4984 CI95 [-0.1161,+1.1244] is positive, so the linear curve never crosses zero at any admissible sigma.
a_zero_crossing.step_form: below tau=4.75 bp, E[g] = -0.1548 CI95 [-0.708,+0.386] = INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM ZERO, not negative.
a_zero_crossing.verdict: NO zero crossing is identified at any dispersion level the book can reach. The honest statement is that E[g] becomes indistinguishable from zero below about 4.75 bp, which is 42% below today's 8.20 and below any month since 2025-10 except 2026-05.

b_at_today.caveat: This is the POOLED estimate. It is era-confounded (finding 4/5) and it failed its only out-of-window test by 4-5 bps/anchor with the wrong sign (finding 6). It must not be used as a planning number on its own.

c_share_earned_above_today.note: But 'levels the book is unlikely to see again' is the wrong reading of 8.20 bp - it is the 69.5th percentile of history, not a ceiling. The right reading of this row is: 76.5% of the historical mean was earned in the top third of the dispersion distribution, and that top third is concentrated in 2025-2026, which is also when the book's construction was being developed.

legs.note: LEGS=001 PHI=0 (fund alone) and LEGS=100 PHI=0 (king alone), same chain, same fitted cost

FUND_only.comment: the fund leg alone is the ONLY arm whose low-dispersion mean is significantly negative (CI excludes zero). It does need fuel. A0 does not inherit that: A0's low-dispersion mean is -0.1548 CI95 [-0.708,+0.386].

KING_only.comment: king alone is flat-to-negative everywhere and its sign vs dispersion is OPPOSITE to the fund leg's; it is not a fuel-dependent sleeve. Shorter support (starts later) - stated, not hidden.

seat_response.comment: the msharpe seat does NOT de-weight the fund leg at low dispersion - if anything it weights it MORE (decile 1 = 0.683). The seat is blind to the fuel gauge.

XIB_LAG50_minus_A0_s42.verdict: XIB's edge does NOT scale with the fuel. It is if anything slightly LARGER below today's dispersion (+0.433 CI excludes zero) than above it (+0.379 CI straddles zero). It is not leverage on the same exposure in the dispersion sense. Reproduced on s2027: +0.4116 [0.1361,0.6856] below vs +0.3179 [-0.0966,0.7370] above.

A0_plus_0.20_Amihud_minus_A0.verdict: the sleeve's Sharpe gain is LARGER at high dispersion (+0.431 vs +0.169) and its delta_g is NEGATIVE there (-0.053). At low dispersion it is the only candidate that adds return (+0.036) rather than only variance, but the CI straddles zero everywhere. Its standalone Sharpe halves from 2.340 to 0.923 when dispersion falls below today's level - it DOES scale with the fuel, in the Sharpe it contributes.

if_dispersion_stays_at_8.20.label: INFERRED, era-confounded, failed its out-of-window test - do not plan to this

trend_extrapolation.label: INFERRED - WEAK BASIS
trend_extrapolation.assumption_stated: that the 8 monthly medians are draws from a deterministic linear (or log-linear) trend in calendar time with iid noise. The series violates this: one step is +10.27 bp and R2 is 0.39/0.31, so the trend explains under 40% of the month-to-month variation. Two of the last 14 months already read BELOW today and then rebounded. No date should be acted on.
trend_extrapolation.and_even_then: reaching 4.75 bp only takes E[g] to -0.1548 CI95 [-0.708,+0.386], i.e. to indistinguishable from zero, not to a loss.

holes: The replay is not the live book. Round 6 measured BOOK term +2.6982 bps/anchor [+0.578,+4.322] between the deployed book and the replay's own book. Every number here is replay-layer.
KING_only has only 5838 post-warm anchors (the king score does not exist for the early panel), so its decile table is not on the same support as the others.
E-0911-B: the incumbent king feature tensor is funding-blind on 2026-08-31 04Z..20Z. Those anchors are past my 2026-08-30 20Z cut, so they are excluded here.

September 2026 has only 55 anchors on the extended panel (2026-09-01..09-10 00Z). Today's dispersion is a 55-anchor median. The live regime dashboard through 2026-09-11 16Z reads 8.42 over 57 anchors, so the number is stable to about +-0.25 bp.

sigma_fund is autocorrelated and the anchors are not independent; all CIs here are UTC-day block bootstraps (B=4000, default_rng([20260912,k])), which handles within-day clustering but not the multi-month persistence that IS the era confound.
The Amihud sleeve arm P6_AMQ64_PWR_s42 and s2027 are numerically identical (the sleeve carries no DL seed), so the two-seed check is vacuous for it.
The decile curve was not pre-registered before the numbers were seen. The out-of-window test in finding 6 is the only genuinely held-out reading in this document.
